Ecografia ostetrica (3/3): misura la tes: Obstetric ultrasound (3/3): measure the fetal head
Circonferenza cranica 259 mm, circa 28 s: Head circumference 259 mm, about 28 weeks; in the third trimester HC does not date the pregnancy (HC18 693)
Ecografia ostetrica del terzo trimestre: Third-trimester obstetric ultrasound for growth. The pregnancy was dated in the first trimester. Axial image of the fetal head.
Misura la circonferenza cranica e decidi: Measure the head circumference and decide how to use it.
La circonferenza cranica (CC) si misura:
Head circumference (HC) is measured on an axial plane of the head: a regular, symmetric oval, continuous midline echo interrupted anteriorly by the cavum septi pellucidi, thalami visible, cerebellum not visible (if the cerebellum is seen the plane is too low and tilted). The ellipse is placed on the outer edge of the skull.
In the first trimester gestational age is dated with the crown-rump length; in the second trimester HC is a good dating parameter. In the third trimester variability between fetuses increases: HC is used to follow growth, not to date the pregnancy (the first-trimester dating is used).
Si data una volta sola, presto; dopo si: Date once, early; afterwards measure growth.
Collezione HC18: circonferenza cranica d: HC18 collection: reference head circumference 258.5 mm (experienced sonographer). Hadlock: about 28 weeks.
Testa fetale in assiale, terzo trimestre: Fetal head, axial view, third trimester
L'immagine è adatta alla misura?: Is the image suitable for measurement?
Come si usa questa misura nel terzo trim: How is this measurement used in the third trimester?
Piano adatto della testa: teca ovale, li: Suitable plane of the head: oval skull, midline with the cavum septi pellucidi (anterior dark triangle)
Immagine 0: il cavo del setto pellucido: Image 0: the cavum septi pellucidi marks the correct plane; the skull is slightly cut by the edge of the sector, but the outline can be reconstructed.
Non adatto: è un piano coronale: Not suitable: it is a coronal plane
Con il righello misura il diametro bipar: With the ruler measure the biparietal diameter (outer to outer edge of the skull) and the occipitofrontal diameter; the circumference is about 1.57 × (BPD + OFD). With an ellipse you measure directly along the outer skull edge.
La misura della testa si confronta con l: The head measurement is compared with growth charts for the gestational age already known from the first trimester; the pregnancy is not re-dated
Con la datazione del primo trimestre, 25: With first-trimester dating, 259 mm corresponds to about 28 weeks according to Hadlock: if the true age is similar, head growth is normal.
Si ricalcola la data del parto in base a: The due date is recalculated from this measurement
Nel terzo trimestre l'errore della dataz: In the third trimester the error of biometric dating is ±2-3 weeks: growth restriction would be missed.
